description: This Java class, ReadableManufacturerPopulator, is responsible for converting (populating) data from a Manufacturer model object to a ReadableManufacturer DTO object. It handles the extraction of manufacturer descriptions matching a specified language, and sets various properties on the target object for use in web layers.

classes.name: ReadableManufacturerPopulator
classes.description: A class that extends AbstractDataPopulator to convert Manufacturer objects into ReadableManufacturer DTOs, including logic to match descriptions based on language.

methods.name: populate
methods.description: Converts a Manufacturer source object into a ReadableManufacturer DTO, filtering descriptions by language and copying relevant properties.

methods.name: createTarget
methods.description: Creates and returns a new instance of ReadableManufacturer; currently returns null, implying it should be overridden or implemented properly.
